paras: This material provides parents and educators with a practical and clear guide to teaching autistic children and young people social skills related to starting and maintaining conversations, through a simple and visual story that models how to greet others, ask questions about the present, the past, the future, and another person’s interests, listen carefully, ask follow-up questions, and end a conversation kindly; in addition, it includes literal comprehension questions, reflection questions, personal connection questions, and learning questions, as well as role-play examples in different everyday contexts to reinforce practice step by step, helping conversations become more understandable, structured, and natural over time.
